name: Alison Hammond's Florida Unpacked
summary: For years Alison worked as a tour rep following in the footsteps of her mother, who was a hard-working, no-nonsense travel agent. Her passion for travel will take audiences of this new series on a journey with her son Aidan. The pair will embark on an adventure-packed exploration of Florida, unveiling the state's hidden gems and providing viewers with practical and budget-friendly travel advice.

name: Pennies
summary: Pennies is about a reclusive forensic pathologist named Penny who is more comfortable with the bodies under her (dogged) care than with real people. Penny solves mysteries and murders stemming from the San Francisco morgue, aided by her over-confident extrovert sister, also named Penny, an attorney in the D.A.'s office.

name: Toys "R" Us Family Faceoff
summary: Toys "R" Us Family Faceoff will seek families competing inside a "larger-than-life" toy store and will integrate a range of nostalgic and popular trending toys and games from classic toy brands.

name: Sutura: A Vida por um Fio
summary: On one side, a talented young man with a strong sense of justice who sees his dreams threatened. On the other, a brilliant surgeon with explosive doses of cynicism, trying to return to surgery after a trauma. United by an unexpected and dangerous situation, they end up forming an unbeatable medical duo.

previousepisode.name: Adivinha quem vai se foder nessa história?

name: Последняя клятва Гиппократа
summary:
Petr Kratov is a former military surgeon, a luminary of medicine. A former respected member of society, a former exemplary family man. Now Petr works as a paramedic in an ambulance team, and lives in the house of his eldest son
Viktor - the head of the department for combating drug trafficking. Victor, out of a sense of filial duty, pulled his father out of the bottom, paid for treatment at a clinic for addiction, settled him in his place, and found a job for his father through friends.
In the ambulance, Kratov is half-jokingly called
Hippocrates - because of the rhyme with the surname and for his morbid commitment to the oath to help any patient in need of help.
A redistribution of the drug market is taking place in the city, and Kratov, against his will, is forced not only to help the leader of a criminal group, of which his youngest son is a member, but also to hide his affairs from his son, a policeman, who is determined to destroy this group.

name: Ciudad de sombras
summary: A gruesome crime has occurred in La Pedrera - Casa Milà: a burning body appears on the façade of Gaudi's emblematic building. Inspector Milo Malart, until now suspended from his job, comes back to activity and, hand in hand with deputy inspector Rebeca Garrido, will try to find the author of this crime.

name: Cities of Success
summary: The pandemic and the success of startup culture have sparked the emergence of new hubs for businesses outside of traditional power centers of New York, Chicago, Houston and San Francisco. These Cities of Success each have used unique characteristics – pop culture influence, clusters of great universities, friendly geography or forward-thinking local governments – to attract major companies and nurture an entrepreneurial community around them.

name: They Call It Late Night with Jason Kelce
summary: They Call It Late Night with Jason Kelce will be an immersive experience from Union Transfer in Philadelphia, showcasing the Super Bowl champion's oversized personality and infectious humor mixed with celebrity guests from the football world and beyond, in front of a live audience of NFL fans. The show's format will position Kelce and his guests to dissect NFL topics and storylines, mainly focused on that weekend's games, in both conventional and good-humoredly unconventional approaches including active participation from the fans in attendance.

name: Feng Yi's World
summary: In the past, the Empress Dowager, in her quest for power, schemed to change Feng Yi's gender, forcing Feng Yi to live a life disguised as a man. Upon reaching adulthood, unwilling to remain a puppet emperor, Feng Yi began to cultivate her own strength. However, her attempts to curry favor with the Prime Minister ended in the Prime Minister's sudden death at a brothel. When she tried to win over the Grand Tutor Sima Qi, he repeatedly attempted to kill her. This is the bitter and tragic life of a woman ruling as the emperor, where a single misstep could cost her life.

name: The Dawn to the Night
summary: Hua Zhaoyang of the Human Moon Sect has spent five hundred years in seclusion, breaking through to the Heavenly Realm and defeating his arch-nemesis, the Asura Ye Tian. To truly become a Heavenly Being, Hua Zhaoyang must fulfill Ye Tian's last wish: to save and prevent him from becoming an Asura. Hua Zhaoyang seals his spirit into a jade and begins a cycle of reincarnation to find Ye Tian's past life, eliminate his malevolence, and awaken him.

name: Renaissance: The Blood and the Beauty
summary:
Renaissance: The Blood and the Beauty explores the lives of three rival artists - Michelangelo, Leonardo and Raphael – who created seductively beautiful works of art during an age of violence and upheaval.

Featuring contributions from contemporary artists Antony Gormley, Alison Lapper, David LaChapelle, a host of experts and a star turn from Charles Dance as the older Michelangelo, this landmark series reveals how some of history's greatest works of art, from Leonardo da Vinci's Mona Lisa to Michelangelo's David, emerged from an era of brutality and bloodshed.

name: Омут
summary: Psychologist Evgeniya, who leaves her former life in the metropolis with her family and returns to her hometown, because the local healing climate is ideal for the health of her teenage daughter. Zhenya's husband believes that here, far from everyone, they will finally be happy. However, in her native land, the heroine unexpectedly meets Artyom, her first love, and feelings flare up with a new force that they cannot resist. But neither Artyom's wife nor Zhenya's husband intend to let them go so easily.

name: Афганский призрак
summary: Andrei Potyomkin, frontier guard cadet, learns that his MIA father who fought in the Soviet-Afghan war is accused of treason. He is trying to find out the truth about his father's death, and together with a young promising journalist Alyona Nikitina, exposes a criminal group of servicemen who trade missiles to mojaheddin and terrorists. They are not ready to let their profitable business go easily...

name: Танец для двоих
summary: Lera is happily married, raising her son Nikita and teaching dance at the best studio in the city. Her son also studies there. Lera is proud of him and prepares him for a dance competition. But one day Nikita decides to go skateboarding, flies out onto the road and breaks his leg. And then he tells his mother that he was hit by a man with a car. Lera decides to find and punish the culprit at all costs. To top it all off, her husband Andrey tells her about her divorce, he started an affair with his boss and leaves the family. Meanwhile, Angela decides to learn a wedding dance, brings her fiancé Ilya to Lera's studio and makes him learn to dance. Lera soon falls in love with her new student and does not suspect that he is the very person she is looking for.

name: Омут
summary:
The film will tell the story of an old summer cottage village, the residents of which have been friends with their families for several generations in a row. Together they meet new summer cottage seasons, celebrate holidays, cope with troubles and failures.

Nika Mstislavova, the heiress of one of the oldest summer residents, who died under rather strange circumstances, settles in the house of her late grandmother and sets herself the goal of finding out the true nature of the mysterious and terrible events taking place in the village...

Nika is immediately overwhelmed by a mass of impressions, new and already forgotten, because the girl grew up in these places, here she was raised by her grandmother after the sudden death of her parents. Many of the faces she meets on the street seem almost family, although these people have changed a lot and aged since Nika left for Moscow. Familiar and unfamiliar summer residents make up a narrow circle of old-timers, many of whom remember and love Nika's grandmother, Veronika Vitoldova, but no one wants to even admit that a real crime could happen in their quiet and cozy little world.

However, Nika does not have to fight for her rights alone. Her common-law husband, the famous Moscow writer Pavlov, and the young architect Vetlitsky, who is building luxurious houses for representatives of the prosperous new elite in the village, are always by her side. They quickly realize that the roots of the crimes go back to the village's past sixty years ago...

name: The Sing Sing Chronicles
summary: The Sing Sing Chronicles is a four-episode exposé built on two-decades of original investigative reporting with unprecedented access to one of America's most notorious prisons. Crafted from an archive of more than 1,000 hours of footage filmed from 2002 to present day, the series tells the story of a journalist and a man convicted of murder who begin as strangers but become like brothers. Their unlikely connection, forged in the cell blocks of Sing Sing Correctional Facility, ignites a search for justice in four unrelated homicide cases.

name: Watashi no Machi no Chiba-kun ha
Balladen om kolonihaven
summary: A garden tenant wants to create a biodiversity project with wild flowers. It's nothing at all for the allotment association's older residents, but the young people are excited.

name: Match Play
summary: I teach 'Jaeyeon', a stuntman who quietly sticks to his principles, and 'Doha', an idol who was cast in an action movie, but he is arbitrarily proud and does not listen. However, Jae-yeon, who is just as stubborn, and Do-ha, who uses tricks, are trained without much effort, and the two eventually become enemies. Then one day, the two bickering as usual was filmed on idol content, and Jaeyeon gains mysterious popularity... and an unexpected situation begins!

name: Vital Signs
summary: In Vital Signs heroine Emmy Correll is in a rut. She wishes her dull, disappointing life was more like her favorite medical drama Vital Signs – where the characters are life-saving heroes with endlessly exciting love lives. But when Emmy's wish comes true, and she is transported INTO the show, she must confront whether this new life is what she truly wants. Waking up in a TV show is disorienting! Especially because in this world, Emmy is apparently a newly hired doctor. But once she gets over the shock, she realizes she's seen every episode; and she knows what's going to happen. And that means here, in this world, she's kind of a genius.

name: Deadly Funny
summary: Melbourne International Comedy Festival's Deadly Funny.

name: Celda 211
summary: Caught in a prison riot, a human rights lawyer poses as an inmate to survive. As he blends in, chaos and personal loss unveil the darkness within him.

name: El Juicio
summary: When a wealthy heir is accused of raping a classmate, a brutal battle erupts between two families-one fighting for justice, the other wielding power, money, and fear to bury the truth. As the war escalates, and secrets unravel, both sets of parents are forced to confront the terrifying lengths they'll go to protect their children-and the haunting realization that morality is never black and white.

name: Unchosen
summary: A psychological thriller set in a conservative Christian sect about a dutiful wife who is set on a dangerous path of emancipation and sexual awakening when she encounters an escaped convict.

name: Drag Race France All Stars
summary: Drag Race France is back with a brand-new season: Drag Race France All Stars. For the first time in the history of the French show, 10 iconic queens return to the stage to claim the ultimate title of Super Queen of French Drag and win 30,000 euros.

name: La Historia de Juana
summary: Juana is a charming young woman who accidentally becomes pregnant. Gabriel Rubio, a man with whom she has nothing in common, but both are predestined to meet. Discover this story full of love, passion, revenge.

name: ¿A Qué Estás Esperando?
summary: Comedy that explores the contradictions of love through two couples who fall in love, but their fear of commitment prevents them from risking losing their independence.

name: Pistirmadagi Osh
summary: Guys from different fields join forces in search of the villains to return the money they invested in their fraudulent structure. The guys find a new office of the criminals and open a cafe nearby undercover to conduct surveillance and bring them to justice.

name: Carita de Ángel
summary: Dulce María is like her name, a sweet 5-year-old girl, full of joy and good feelings. With the death of her mother, her father, Luciano Larios, sinks into depression and pain, and decides to distance himself from everything and everyone.

name: Sophie et Virginie
summary: Sisters Sophie and Virginia live happily in a mansion with their archaeologist parents. Their world turns upside down when they lose their parents in a plane crash and are sent to an orphanage.

name: IceGuys
summary: A comedic TV series that follows the journey of the newly formed boy band, IceGuys, as they strive for stardom. Led by real-life Icelandic celebrities Aron Can, Friðrik Dór, Herra Hnetusmjör, Jón Jónsson, and Rúrik Gíslason

name: Angemessen Angry
summary: After being raped, chambermaid Amelie develops superpowers that allow her to identify and fight sex offenders. She suppresses her own trauma and judges good and evil - until she meets her own rapist.

previousepisode.name: От попсы до путинской пропаганды. Секрет успеха главных продюсеров России

name: Winter Is Not the Death of Summer, But the Birth of Spring
summary: Pathomkan is serving 1 year and 6 months sentence for a check fraud law. In prison, he meets Bible, a young man who seems indifferent to life yet possesses a magnetic pull that draws Pathomkan in. Bible is the reason Pathomkan can smile. He is the person Pathomkan wants to wake up to every morning. He fills Pathomkan‘s time in prison with countless memories. And he is the person that making it impossible for Pathomkan to forget their bond. This is the story of people's love of the unloved, but they yearn for affection and being loved in the prison filled with strangers.

name: Aerial Australia
summary: Aerial Australia takes viewers on a breathtaking airborne odyssey across this diverse continent unveiling a tapestry of awe-inspiring landscapes that exist alongside the rich heritage of one of the oldest living cultures on Earth.

name: Carl the Collector
summary: Carl the Collector follows the everyday adventures of Carl, a warm-hearted autistic raccoon who enjoys collecting things and loves his friends and family in Fuzzytown. In each episode, Carl and his friends work and play together. In the process, they find out what makes each of them who they are.

name: Yachting Sail GP Highlights
summary: Highlights of the Yachting Sail GP competition.

name: Addicted Only to You
summary: Because of her father's medical expenses, Lin Mian is desperate and almost goes astray. Fortunately, she is saved by the kind-hearted doctor Shi Lin. Shi Lin is attracted by her weakness and strength, and builds a fortress of love for her to resist the darkness. Under Shi Lin's protection, Lin Mian transforms and grows, and the two welcome the light together.

name: Le Parloir
summary: Félix Séguin and Victoria Charlton invite experts from the criminal world to confess. Investigations, disappearances, encounters with the underworld and archives that have marked the collective memory will come together in the crime headquarters. Through different segments, the experts tell their stories as varied as they are surprising, which will delight crime lovers.

name: 暧昧失温
summary:
《暧昧失温》是一部网络短剧，全剧共78集，围绕主角贺枭与许倾欢之间复杂微妙的情感纠葛展开。贺枭，一位在外界眼中冷峻孤傲的商业精英，实则内心深藏着对真爱的渴望。许倾欢，一个温柔善良、独立自主的女性，她的出现意外地打破了贺枭平静的生活。

两人因一次偶然的机会相遇，随后在工作中频繁交集，逐渐产生了一种超越友情的暧昧情愫。然而，这份感情却如同剧名所示，始终保持着一种微妙的"失温"状态，既不够热烈到足以称为爱情，又难以回归到普通朋友的界限。

剧情中，贺枭与许倾欢在相互试探与靠近中，经历了误会、分离与重逢。随着剧情的深入，两人内心的真实情感逐渐被揭露，他们不得不面对自己内心的渴望与恐惧，以及外界的重重压力。最终，在一系列波折之后，两人能否跨越重重障碍，让这份暧昧失温的感情升温至真爱，成为全剧最大的悬念。

《暧昧失温》以其紧凑的剧情、细腻的情感描绘和深刻的主题探讨，吸引了众多观众的关注与喜爱。

name: Stitching Life and Death
summary: Ma San, the heir to the Yin-Yang Tailor, wields mystical needlework to save defense attorney Song Yuan from the brink of death. Together, they uncover strange cases, restoring justice to the common people. In the end, they bring a corrupt official and his son to justice.

name: A Ninja and an Assassin Under One Roof
summary: Satoko Kusagakure, a female ninja who left her village with her comrades, finds herself living with Konoha, a high school girl working as an assassin in the city. Satoko possesses the ability to transform objects using ninjutsu, which catches Konoha's attention. They strike a deal: Konoha provides Satoko with a place to live in exchange for Satoko's help in cleaning up after her assassination jobs. As they face off against assassins sent by Satoko's village, indulge in delicious meals using money earned from assassination jobs, and navigate the chaos of their unusual living situation, the story captures the heartwarming yet chaotic lives of these two unlikely roommates.

previousepisode.name: A Ninja and an Assassin Under One Roof

name: Troy Kingi's Desert Hikoi
summary:
Multi-award-winning Māori musician and actor Troy Kingi is up to his eighth album in his ambitious 10/10/10 mission, where he aims to record 10 albums in 10 genres in 10 years.

However, for the past few years, writer's block has caused Troy's creative river to run dry.

In the hopes of sourcing some much-needed inspiration for his upcoming desert-rock album (a first-love genre for him), Troy makes the journey from Kerikeri to Joshua Tree to fulfil a lifelong dream of recording at one of the most iconic music studios in the world, Rancho De La Luna.

With the ambitious schedule of writing and recording an entire album in just 10 days, Troy and his band need to dig deep. Luckily for them, the Joshua Tree desert is filled with lots of interesting and eccentric locals who are more than happy to help Troy and the band get inspired.

Desert Hīkoi isn't just a music documentary; it's the journey of a group of artists finding their richest vein of creativity, whilst going deep within and learning about themselves.

name: Piri's Tiki Tour
summary: Piri Weepu swaps his rugby boots for tramping boots as he hunts, fishes, forages and explores the Māori communities of Aotearoa.

name: The Nipple Talk
summary: Pony, along with her college friends Leslie (gay) and Xuan (lesbian), explores the romantic relationships each of them desires. Through interactions with different partners, they gradually understand their own bottom lines and genuine emotional needs. They often gather at Mama's AS Bistro bar to share their relationship frustrations and seek advice from Mama. Despite their different sexual orientations, they sincerely share their longings and frustrations in love, striving to overcome their personalflaws to find relationships that make them feel comfortable. No label, no tag, just love is the key spirit in this show.

name: JUNG KOOK: I AM STILL > THE ORIGINAL
summary: In the 2020s, JUNG KOOK emerged as a top solo artist. He won over audiences with chart-topping hits like "Seven," "3D," and "Standing Next to You." To this day, he still gives his all to make ARMY proud, and is constantly striving to improve and evolve. Instead of resting on his laurels with his natural talent and impressive career, he continues to blaze his own trail. From his solo career launch single to the promotion of his album GOLDEN, experience eight months of Jung Kook's golden life as he travels the globe, visiting cities like New York, London, and Seoul. This is the story of Jung Kook, an artist who never stops dreaming.

name: Thanksgiving in America
summary: Highlights from Thanksgiving Day parades in cities across the country will air live, including in New York City, Philadelphia, Chicago, Houston, and Detroit. CNN correspondents will provide on-the-ground reporting from celebrations nationwide.

name: Richard Ramirez: The Night Stalker Tapes
summary:
Nearly 40 years after his summertime reign of terror on the streets of Los Angeles, the myth of the "Night Stalker" still looms large. Now, a series of prison recordings of Richard Ramirez unearths new truths in the Peacock original docuseries Richard Ramirez: The Night Stalker Tapes.   

Collected from more than 25 hours of audio recordings – most of which have never been heard before – and including revealing interviews with his family, friends and wife, the series explores the dark forces that led Ramirez to become the infamous Night Stalker.   

Plus, some of the women impacted by Ramirez over the years share their experiences, from former friends to victims' families, and his own niece, who speaks out for the first time in a documentary. The series also goes inside the confounding love story of a former teen magazine editor who fell in love with Ramirez and eventually became his wife.

name: Liar: Surechigau Koi
summary:
This is the story of Ichikawa Kazuya and Narita Misao during the empty four years when they decided to split and spend their time apart. During the four years, Kazuya couldn't get along with his new girlfriend. He fell into a relationship slump and realised that he couldn't stop thinking about Misao. Misao, on the other hand, devoted herself to her work.

Deno Tsukasa is the boss of Kazuya and was appointed as the general manager at a young age. One night, Tsukasa was led by a cat and arrived at a bar. There, he met a mysterious woman called Nao. Tsukasa and Nao were attracted to each other but continued to have a relationship while hiding their real thoughts.

name: Into Your Heart
summary: In the Tiansheng Kingdom, Su Fengzhi, the youngest daughter of General Su Lie, faces a family tragedy orchestrated by her scheming brother-in-law. She joins forces with Third Prince Jian Qingxun, another victim of the conspiracy, and together they navigate deadly trials and personal conflicts. United by love and a shared thirst for vengeance, they seek justice and a chance to start anew.

name: Meeting you at the center of the world

previousepisode.name: To the Space over the Spacetime!
Лучшие школы мира. Как учатся без оценок, звонков, травли, но с классом для йоги | Дима Зицер

name: Dare You to Death
summary:
When life gives them only two choices, Truth or Dare, will they tell the truth or take the dare? And if it were you, what would you choose?

The story follows the first encounter between two completely different men, Captain Jade and foreign-trained Inspector Kamin. They have to compete and uncover the real killer behind a mysterious death case. The deeper they investigate, the more bodies begin to fall! But amid all the dangers, there is still a touch of romance that makes the heart race.

name: Head 2 Head
summary: Head 2 Head follows the relationship between rivals Jerome and Jin. It began with childhood hatred, and even in college, they stuck together, studying fashion design. They lived opposite each other, shared the same group of friends, and even had close families. Despite their efforts to rekindle their relationship, it never worked. Instead, they developed a simmering hatred that led to them clinging to each other. Ultimately, the heavens seemed to be playing a joke. Jerome had a dream 10 years in the future, and saw that the person he currently hates to death would eventually become his life partner. What started as a simple annoyance, turned into a feeling he never imagined. Two relationships that were destined. No matter how much they hate each other or how much they push each other away, believe me when I say that what you hate will come true. It's true.

name: Burnout Syndrome
summary: This love triangle begins when Jira gets fired, and now he's suffering from burnout syndrome. To sooth his troubled heart, he visits a bar where he meets Pheem, an IT guy who charms Jira enough for them to exchange contact and stay in touch. Koh Korrawick is the businessman who owns a famous e-commerce platform. Koh is also a mystery, a kind of shut-in, who hates meeting people. He's looking for someone to be his "face" and conduct his business for him. When he meets Jira in a restaurant, Jira's fearless strength imprints a strong impression on him. Meanwhile, for Jira, the mysterious air around Koh captivates him and inspires him to put charcoal to papers again, sketching the outline of Koh's body. That is the first time Jira feels alive making his tedious art. Within the close proximity, Jira is torn between his relationships with Koh and with Pheem. What kind of love does he exactly want?

name: I Love "A Lot Of" You
summary:
Sun is a womanizer who breaks women's hearts for a living. This time, he is hired to break Sairung's heart. She is a reporter for an online news agency. Sairung is bright, confident, and sexy. The next day, he meets her again. But her personality has completely changed. She becomes quiet, cold, and unfriendly. Moreover, she doesn't recognize him even though they met yesterday. Sun finds out that her strange behaviors are similar to those who have multiple personality disorders. In total, she has five different personalities.

Sairung's father, Thepchai, who secretly hires Sun, stumbles upon an unproven theory: if every personality falls in love with the same person, the identities may reunite into one. Armed with charm, wit, and every trick in the book, Sun takes on the challenge of making each version of Sairung fall for him. Will he succeed?

name: Whale Store xoxo
summary:
Wan suddenly loses her job, and to make things worse, her father dies of a heart attack. This forces her to take care of an old grocery store. There, she meets Maewnam, along with a cup of instant noodles labeled with a note: "For a customer at 11 PM." Who would come to buy food at a grocery store at this hour?

That customer turns out to be Maewnam and yes, that is because Wan was Maewnam's love at first sight in the past. She starts hitting on Wan again, head over heels in love. The story reaches her friends, Prof. Chompoo and Prof. Tonnam. Whenever Maewnam consults them about Wan, their opinions always go in opposite directions. What should Maewnam do to win Wan's heart?

previousepisode.name: A good beginning makes a good ending.

name: Welcome to Japan, Ms. Elf!
summary: Kazuhiro Kitase's only hobby? Sleeping, of course. Since childhood, his dreams have been a portal to exhilarating adventures with an elf girl. During one of their explorations through ancient ruins, they both get scorched by a dragon, and Kazuhiro wakes up like usual. Except this time, he finds a familiar figure in bed beside him—the elf girl from his dreams.

previousepisode.name: It's a Blizzard of Cherry Blossom Petals, Ms. Elf.

name: Only Friends: Dream On
summary: Senior theater student Jack sets out to create an ambitious stage production, Romeo & Romeo—a bold, male–male reimagining of the classic Romeo & Juliet. What begins as a dream project soon becomes an emotional minefield when Jack casts friends, exes and their admirers. As rehearsals intensify, unresolved feelings, unspoken crushes, desire, jealousy, and rivalry spiral out of control. Caught between art and emotion, six friends find their relationships tested to the limit.

name: That Summer
summary:
The stories of that summer… would change him forever.

When Lava, a mischievous young man, is sent to stay with Uncle Peng on an island to reform his behavior during the summer, he expects a carefree vacation. But everything changes when he encounters a mysterious young man washed up unconscious on the beach. With no memory of who he is, Lava finds himself responsible for taking care of him, unaware that he is, in fact, a prince.

name: My Romance Scammer
summary: Pai and North, the nephews of a billionaire tycoon and heirs to the Jiramongkolthanan empire, fall victim to two scammers, Yu and Tim, who marry them for their fortunes! North secretly ties the knot with Yu, only to discover he's been conned. Worse, he can't get a divorce because he's already signed over part of his assets!! Meanwhile, Tim is busy planning his upcoming wedding with Pai. Will Tim be exposed as a scammer who has been playing Pai all along!? When love begins with lies, where does it lead?

name: Melody of Secrets
summary: Botpleng, a young man who has lost his memory from an accident, has received a mysterious diary telling him that he used to have a lover named Tankhun. Yet, after meeting him, Botpleng knows right away that he is not his lover, Tankhun! Botpleng uses a mysterious murder case that happened on the day he met Tankhun as an excuse to get close to him and find out the truth. That makes Botpleng all the more impressed and swayed by this Tankhun. How will this love full of secrets unravel? What will become of Botpleng and Tankhun?

name: Love You Teacher
summary: The peaceful life of Teacher Pobmek, a strict-looking primary school teacher who doesn't get along well with children, is about to be turned upside down when his cheerful boyfriend, Teacher Solar, gets into an accident that causes his mind to reset to that of a seven-year-old in an adult body every other day! Things get even more chaotic when Teacher Jee shows up as a new passionate and well-rounded primary school teacher, making his childhood friend Pobmek pale in comparison, so much so that Teacher Sodchuen, the acting principal, can't help but worry about the future of Teacher Pobmek's career and love life.  Will this love end in complete disaster, or will it become the warmest lesson of a teacher's life?

name: MU-TE-LUV
summary: The MU-NIVERSE franchise features seven series, including "Hi" By My Luck, Not My Father, Diva Deva Mata starring Fluke Nattanon, Fist Foot Fusion, Hello' Is This Luck?, Love Me If You Swear, and Love Lock.  Each story portrays a unique journey to finding love. Will the higher power help turn their luck around? Will their wishes be granted?

previousepisode.name: Love Me if You Swear Episode 4

name: Cat for Cash
summary: Cat for Cash is a heartwarming story about cat lovers and a gang of cats unfolds when Tiger, a kind-hearted young creditor who adores cats, unexpectedly gains the special ability "to talk and hear cats" from Je Meow, a cat café owner, shortly before her death. The cats in the café then ask Tiger to help prevent Lynx, Je Meow's son, from selling the café. Matters become more complicated when Leo, Lynx's half-brother from the father's side, and Dr. Pomme, a charming veterinarian, enter the picture. Together, they become entangled in the effort to keep the cat café running while confronting unresolved family conflicts. How can the language of cats spark love among them?

name: Girl Rules
summary: A friend group descends into chaos as their bonds are tested in a variety of ways, beginning with the return of an ex-girlfriend. Prim and Min are running an advertising company together when a new client Bambi, Prim's ex, shows up wanting to get back together. Adding to their circle is Prim's young stylist Gorya who's after a deeper connection, promiscuous and charming model Shasha, and Praew, the lesbian photographer from the bar bi-curious Min frequents.

name: Boys in Love
summary: Hop on the rollercoaster of love among 12th graders! Shane, a smart and driven student who excels in academics and school activities, has no interest in teenage life. That is, until he meets Kit, a carefree student who's his complete opposite. Forced to spend time together, sparks fly in unexpected ways. Meanwhile, Kim, another of Shane's classmates, is a hopeless romantic determined to find love before graduation. When he meets Mon, a new transfer student, Kim decides to do whatever it takes to win his heart. This new semester, open your heart to chaotic love experiences!

name: My Magic Prophecy
summary:
In, a gifted tarot reader, is asked by his best friend, Thordao, to give a false reading to her mom as a personal favor. At her house, he runs into Thapfah, an ICU doctor and Thordao's blunt older brother, who has no patience for fortune tellers. In blurts out a chilling prediction warning that a streak of misfortune is coming for Dr. Thapfah, so severe it could even cost him his life.

Dr. Thapfah brushes it off at first. But as a series of unfortunate events hit, even his closest friend, Dr. Pokpong, and Police Inspector Ton suggest he lie low for a while. With few options left, Dr. Thapfah reluctantly agrees to retreat to Mae Hong Son with In.

name: A Dog and a Plane
summary: The strikingly handsome flight attendant Kanit lives inside the first-class life he has carefully built for himself. But that perfect world begins to fall apart the moment he meets Toto. Bold, carefree, mischievous, and sharp-tongued, Toto is the head of a rescue team—and the complete opposite of Kanit in every possible way. Yet fate keeps throwing them together. What begins with a simple luggage mix-up soon pulls them into each other's lives in ways neither of them can escape. Then comes the real mission: Kanit suspects his handsome pilot boyfriend, Lion, of cheating. Determined to uncover the truth, he drags Toto into an undercover plan to catch the third party in the act. But as the two bickering men chase clues, trade insults, and stumble through one chaotic situation after another, they slowly begin to see the softest parts of each other's hearts.

name: Me and Thee
summary: Thee Theerakit Kian Lee, the eldest son of an ex-mafia, left his past in arms trafficking behind to launch a perfume and accessories brand called Arseni. Chaos erupts when Mr. Thee has his eyes on  Aran, a model close to Peach Peachayarat, a famous freelance photographer shooting the brand's new perfume collection. Peach loves his quiet, introverted life—but it's turned upside down forever when he's roped into becoming Mr. Thee's love coach, only to be pursued by him instead in over-the-top ways, as if trying to set a new world record in wooing.

name: WU
summary: Pete, a luckless man with a shard of demon spirit hidden inside him, can sense the presence of Yao, a strange devouring evil force that controls the mind of men. He meets Nirund who introduces him to the world of Wu. The two fall into a necessary partnership and must team up with others to suppress Yao and defeat the evil of the world. Will Nirund, Pete, and their team be able to get through this challenge, and how exactly are their souls intertwined?

name: Memoir of Rati
summary: From the pages of the memoir of Rati, an orphan born of a commoner who has been adopted by an aristocrat, who returns to Siam for the first time in 20 years as an interpreter for the French ambassador. There, he meets Theeratorn, a marquis in the Ministry of Education. Their love at first sight turns into companionship, which then turns into love. But this love blooms among various constraints and conflicts of its time. Just like the taboo of social differences between Mek, a lowly commoner, and Baronnet Dech which threatens their budding friendship. Does true love pull through everything?

name: Ticket to Heaven
summary: Tanrak is a devout young man determined to pursue the priesthood in hopes of reuniting with his parents in heaven. His heart is put to the test when he meets Barth, a new friend with deep emotional wounds. Amidst the ironclad rules of the school and the watchful eyes of Father Arnon, a bond that transcends friendship begins to bloom. When faith clashes with forbidden feelings, Tanrak must choose between the path to God and the path of love. Where exactly does their true heaven lie?

name: Discontinued
summary: Broadcast from the future, Discontinued is a show about the past... a past before the world domination of A.I.. With introspection and humor, we look at products, experiences- and everything in between- that remind us of humankind's memorable past.

previousepisode.name: Family Matters, DisneyQuest, Dream Phone, Ice Breakers Liquid Ice

name: Ranchland Listings
summary: Ranchland Listings is a series that follows the thrilling world of multi-million dollar ranch properties across the USA and Canada. Spotlighting passionate owners, elite real estate agents, and wealthy buyers as they navigate the rugged, luxurious landscape of these sprawling estates. Each episode reveals the unique challenges, and jaw-dropping beauty of expansive properties. From mountainous retreats to plains-side hideaways, viewers get an inside look at the fascinating, high-stakes process of buying and selling dream ranches, where deals hinge on vision, charisma and expertise in this niche but lucrative market.

name: Il Capo Perfetto
summary: Giulio Zagni is The Perfect Boss, the beloved and undisputed king of his steering wheel factory and his family. Friends, relatives, and employees may veer off course, but Giulio is always there to set things right, no matter the cost. However, when this well-oiled machine suddenly falters, the professional and personal life of this exemplary entrepreneur in Italy's Motor Valley spirals out of control. Amid tragicomic twists and strokes of genius, will Giulio manage to get back on track?

name: Vóta 2024
summary: TG4 is delighted to present Vóta 2024, a comprehensive two-day live event covering the results and detailed analysis of this year's general election. Hosted by Siún Nic Gearailt and Eimear Ní Chonaola, these special broadcasts will bring viewers expert insights, live result updates, and in-depth commentary as the nation charts its political future.

name: Virgin Media News Special
summary: Virgin Media News brings you all the latest updates as votes are counted in General Election 2024.

name: Ed Finn's America
summary: Welcome to Ed Finn's America, where I'm taking you on an unforgettable journey across some of the most vibrant and historic cities in the US.

name: Silent River
summary: Told through the lens of two men whose lives are far more connected than they realize, Silent River explores the cracks of small-town America in the wake of discovering a serial killer among them.

name: Baijia Jue Zhi Jianghu Guishi Lu
Tokimeki Bakudan
summary: The story begins with six men trapped inside an unfamiliar, abandoned warehouse, each with a mysterious collar around their necks. They have no idea how they got there or what's happening, but their confusion quickly turns to shock when a plushie dog begins to speak.

name: Kerviel : Un Trader, 50 Milliards
summary: Jérôme Kerviel -- the trader who hid €50 billion in trades at a major international bank -- and his former superiors reveal all sides of the scandal.

name: Harlan Coben's I Will Find You
summary: Harlan Coben's I Will Find You follows an innocent father serving life in prison for murdering his own son, who receives evidence that his child may actually still be alive — and must break out of prison to find the truth.

name: Pulisic
summary: The series provides unprecedented access to Pulisic's life and growing celebrity in Italy as he competes in UEFA Champions League and Serie A competitions. Cameras capture Pulisic's journey in meeting the demands of global stardom while he prepares for the biggest moment of his career - the 2026 FIFA Men's World Cup on home soil.

name: Женщина в истории
summary: The unique and fascinating history of Russia was not created only by men. Among those who led and directed the chronology of events, there are many great women who certainly cannot be called the "weaker sex". The authors tell about scientists and writers, designers and engineers, artists and politicians who converted and changed the country for the better.

previousepisode.name: Майя Плисецкая: Икона балета и неизвестные факты о её жизни

name: Eyes on You
summary: Two years ago, Just abandoned his law studies and severed ties with Rule to uncover the truth behind his parents' murder. Two years later, Rule, now a lawyer, still haunted by Just's disappearance, finally tracks him down to a seedy Gogo Bar, only to find him embroiled in a deadly feud with the Kung gang. But Just isn't alone. The bar is a haven for those consumed by vengeance:Salt, the security guard who always with bloody smell, the runaway teen Tiger, and Ice, the ruthless madam running sexual business for the gang. Each carries the scent of violence, a simmering powder keg waiting to explode. Are you ready to descend into their dark, bloody, and tear-soaked path to retribution?

name: Rage Against the Regime: Iran
summary: Facing danger, risking persecution. Witnesses and survivors reveal the truth about anti-government protests in Iran, from 2009's contested election to the fight for women's rights.

name: La Vie sa Bhruiséil
summary: Series following some of the Gaeilgeoirí building careers and homes in Brussels, the multilingual capital of Europe.

name: RTÉ Sport Awards
summary: Joanne Cantwell, Darragh Maloney and Jacqui Hurley present the RTÉ Sport Awards 2024.

name: An Post Irish Book of the Year
summary: A look at the shortlist and winner of the An Post Irish Book of the Year 2024.

previousepisode.name: An Post Irish Book of the Year 2025

nextepisode.name: An Post Irish Book of the Year 2026

name: Search and Rescue: The Alpha Team
summary: Teens at the Alpha Ranch wildlife preserve join forces with trained animals to rescue people in danger. The Alpha Team, comprised of humans and animals, acts as a search and rescue unit. Led by Bob Donell and his children, Kathy and Jim, they respond whenever someone is lost, injured, or stranded. Each episode highlights the unique abilities of specific animals for their rescue missions. Featured wildlife includes a raccoon, lion, black bear, otter, hawk, cougar, chimpanzee, donkey, St. Bernard, and jaguar. Based in the Midwest, the Donell family is ready for on-call missions around the world, from remote rural areas to city streets.

name: Silo
summary: Raised during the apocalypse in an underground home, a young man and his siblings must venture into a nuclear-active world filled with monsters.

name: The Family Next Door
summary:
Propelled by a mystery that disrupts a seemingly harmonious beachside community, the series explores the universal challenges of motherhood, marriage, friendship, and the complexities of identity. 

It's peak holiday season in the popular seaside town of Osprey Point when an enigmatic stranger, Isabelle rents a family home in a quiet cul-de-sac. As Isabelle charms her way into her neighbours' homes and lives, she quickly discovers that everyone at Pleasant Court has something to hide. How far will her obsessive drive to solve a mystery push her to expose the truth?

name: Dostoevskij
summary: In a sparse and inhospitable land, the policeman Enzo Vitello, a man with a dark past, is obsessed with "Dostoyevsky", a serial killer whom he kills with a peculiarity: next to the body, the murderer always leaves a letter with his desolate and very clear vision of the world, of life and darkness that Vitello hears resonating in him.

previousepisode.name: Non siate crudeli con un finale

name: Full Sweat
summary:
Ahead of the highly anticipated 2025 Toyota AFL Premiership Season, the Seven Network has announced the Hawthorn Football Club will be the subject of a behind-the-scenes pre-season documentary, Full Sweat, to be broadcast exclusively on Seven and 7plus Sport.

The multi-part docuseries will give AFL fans a unique, inner-sanctum look into the 2025 AFL pre-season, where Sam Mitchell's side will be aiming to build on their memorable 2024 finals berth.

With key figures of the brown and gold set to feature, Seven will take viewers behind the scenes in an access all areas documentary, as the Hawks embark on one of their biggest years yet, both on and off the field.

The unmissable documentary is set to be released before the 2025 AFL season gets underway on Seven and streamed on 7plus Sport.

name: Vision Australia's Carols by Candlelight
summary: Each year, Vision Australia's Carols by Candlelight brings families together as a cherished Australian tradition, featuring some of the biggest stars in music and musical theatre, all generously donating their time to support Vision Australia.

previousepisode.name: Vision Australia's Carols by Candlelight presented by AAMI

name: Ascetic Love
summary: Ran Shuang, who was once the best trader on Wall Street, agreed to marry Fu Zhi Heng in order to repay his financial support. After three years of marriage, the two had not had sex. Ran Shuang thought that Fu Zhi Heng was thinking about his childhood sweetheart Lu Meng Lian. But in fact, it was because Fu Zhi Heng was abused by the nanny when he was a child, and he had a psychological shadow since then and could not have substantial contact with women. After being repeatedly ignored by Fu Zhi Heng, Ran Shuang decided to let go and leave, and Fu Zhi Heng gradually realized his feelings for Ran Shuang and resolutely pursued his wife.

name: Cinderella Game
summary: A woman was used as a fake daughter by her enemy and became the embodiment of revenge. She grows and heals as she realizes the true meaning of revenge.

name: Работяги
summary: An extreme reality show in which working people from across the country compete for 10 million rubles. Leading the show is Olympic figure skating champion Roman Kostomarov.

name: The Summer Hikaru Died
summary: Six months ago, Hikaru vanished for a week. Now, as his best friend Yoshiki senses something amiss and confronts him, the harrowing truth emerges.

name: The Reason We Fall in Love
summary: Three couples face bittersweet challenges in love: a farewell approaches, a relationship strains under conflict, and work disrupts holiday plans. What will their futures hold?

name: Gino & Fred: Emission Impossible
summary: Gino D'Acampo and Fred Sirieix go on an eco-friendly journey through Austria and Croatia. From glacier rowing to trying vegetarian options and agrotourism, they explore local culture while embracing sustainable travel.

name: Finding Mr. Christmas
summary: 10 men compete in a series of festive challenges that will showcase their acting chops and their holiday spirit. Jonathan Bennett hosts while these lovable guys vie to become the next Hallmark leading man.

name: Love Trap
summary: To get close to the indulgent warlord Yan Xuan, Jiang Yao, a member of the anti-warlord organization, Feiwu, pretends to be an item at an underground auction, hoping to be bidded by him. As the target is about to fall into the trap, Jiang Yao's plan is unexpectedly disrupted by a mysterious man who bids a high price for her. Only when the mysterious man walks into the spotlight does she realize that he is actually her old flame from five years ago—Chi Yanzhou! At present, Chi Yanzhou's loving gaze has turned glares of hatred. It turns out that he was the first target of the Feiwu Organization, and Jiang Yao, who has returned from studying abroad, is chosen as an undercover agent. With time and interactions, the two gradually fall in love. For the big picture, Jiang Yao ultimately chooses to complete the mission, but it indirectly leads to the death of Chi's father and the disappearance of Chi Yanzhou. When they reunite after a long time, Chi Yanzhou has become extremely powerful. With a heart for revenge, he tries every means to torture and humiliate Jiang Yao, both causing chaos in Jiang Yao's life and plunging into deeper agony.

name: La Palma
summary: A Norwegian family vacationing on La Palma faces disaster when a young researcher discovers alarming signs of an imminent volcanic eruption.

name: Пустые города
summary: In the midst of the epidemic, former criminal investigation operative Viktor Pugachev returns to his native Severoneftyansk, where the infection was known only from the news at that time. No one is happy for him here, because it is after his arrival that residents one by one begin to catch the coronavirus. The infection is spreading so fast that even the head of the criminal investigation department, David Yeghiazaryan, is ready to panic: the city is about to be quarantined, which means that the crime rate will rise sharply, and there is simply no one to fight it. The lieutenant colonel, in order to prepare for the worst-case scenario, gathers back his old department, which was dissolved five years ago due to the loss of important evidence. He can offer nothing but the certificates of the vigilante, nevertheless three out of four, including Pugachev, agree to work on these conditions, another promises to think about it. It quickly becomes clear to colleagues that the deadly epidemic is not the main reason why people in the city suddenly began to die more often than usual…

name: МУР есть МУР
summary: 1953. After Stalin's death, there was more work in MUR. A new era had arrived - hundreds of criminals were released. The spirit of permissiveness swept across Moscow. Aleksandr Ivanovich Smirnov, the head of the operational group of the first department of MUR, has a lot of work - new murders and robberies occur in the city every day... Film adaptations of Anatoly Stepanov's novels "The Concerns of the Fifty-Third", "The Wooden Samovar", "The Pilgrims' Halt".

name: Power Play with Vassy Kapelos
summary: Power Play, a daily look at Canada's political landscape. Recorded in Ottawa featuring all the political news and issues that matter most. Hosted by CTV's Vassy Kapelos, the program is a must for political insiders.

name: Destination X
summary: A road trip across Europe. An adventure full of little clues and deceptive images. A scavenger hunt in which eight celebrities constantly ask themselves ONE question: Where am I? In Destination X, eight celebrities go on a blind road trip. Their challenge: They have to determine their whereabouts as accurately as possible. Their travel companion: The opaque "Destination X" bus, which knows its secret routes but leaves its passengers in the dark.

name: DC Heroes United
summary: When the story of Earth-212 begins our favorite Super Heroes and Super-Villains remain in the shadows, largely unknown to one another and mostly serving as legend and rumor to civilians. The appearance of the magical Tower of Fate in Gotham City thrusts these fledgling heroes into the spotlight – together and in opposition.

name: Jonathan Ross Haunted Homecoming
summary: Jonathan Ross returns to the scenes of his youth, to discover the darker side of London's East End and the sinister secrets hidden within.

name: The Way Home
summary: Set against the backdrop of traditional dragon boat racing in southern China, separated cousins reunite after a family tragedy. Answering the call of the race, they break through barriers of bloodline and rebuild familial bonds. Together, they join the competition, mending relationships, forging friendships, and discovering life's purpose.

name: My Destiny
summary: This drama tells the story of Fang Wanzhi, a post-70s woman who leaves the mountains of Southwest China to build a life in Shenzhen. It begins with her breaking free from the constraints of her family. Through life's hardships, she finds her true worth. It's also a powerful reflection of the deep connection between individual destiny and Reform and Opening-up.

name: Жизнь и смерть Леньки Пантелеева
summary: In the recent past, Lenka was a police officer. Who would have thought that at some point he would become completely disillusioned with the system and become one of the most wanted criminals in the country?

name: Следы апостолов
summary: Alevtina, a student of the Faculty of Law, goes to her grandmother's summer practice in Nesvizh. On the way, the girl meets a strange man Grigory, who tells her the legend about the Radziwills' treasures. Berlin during the Third Reich, Nesvizh in 1942 and the present serve as a historical background against which exciting events unfold in the search for the family heirloom of the Radziwill family - the golden statues of the Twelve Holy Apostles. Legends and reality, secrets and mysticism, murder and love intertwined in this search and confrontation between Soviet and German intelligence, members of occult societies and other heroes of the film.

name: Богатая и любимая
summary: One terrible day, the most ordinary English teacher Dasha Muratova will be forced to radically change her way of life. Without wanting it, she will become the head of a large Moscow pharmaceutical concern. Until that moment, its owner was her older brother Vladimir Muratov, but he died under mysterious circumstances. A yacht explosion took his life, his wife died with him, and a fire destroyed all the material evidence that shed light on the case. Grief-stricken Dasha is left with a growing orphan Katya and the largest pharmaceutical holding "Gipppokrat". In general - goodbye to the usual life in the provinces, high school, a big break and gatherings in the teachers' room with her friend Lariska - hello Moscow and the work of restoring and re-launching a mothballed medical plant. It won't be easy for the "Reluctant Pharmaceutical Queen" - she will have to take the pharmacy business with an iron fist, otherwise the "local mafia" has become too unruly. The plant's manager, Lidiya Sototskaya, produces her "left" drugs at the company's facilities, and each of the employees and friends is trying to keep

name: La Familia - House of Reality
summary: In the reality experiment, four cool personalities open the doors to their shared apartment in Munich. TV Casanova Yasin Mohamed meets TV celebrity Melina Hoch and Instagram icons Celina Weisner and Fabia Bengs.

name: Adam Richman Eats Football
summary: Adam Richman combines his two great passions, food and football. He visits Britain's most famous teams and seeks out footie's finest foods.

name: Land of the Iberian Lynx
summary:
The Iberian lynx is one of the most beautiful and scarcest feline species in the world. On the verge of extinction, its population is slowly beginning to recover. Over the course of a year, this series reveals the intimate life of the Iberian lynx in the mountains of Sierra Morena, in Andalusia, southern Spain.

Through breathtaking cinematography, the series follows the lynxes in their struggle for survival, from the thrill of the hunt to the tender moments of parenting, and witnesses the coexistence with other animals like majestic golden eagles, playful otters, vigilant rabbits or powerful deer.

This wildlife series is a celebration of the comeback of this unique feline and a call to keep protecting it from the challenges of the future.

name: Nature's Ultimate Survivors
summary: This series explore's the top 10 extraordinary abilities creatures have evolved to make it in the animal kingdom.

name: Once Upon a Time in Tsavo
summary: In arid regions across Africa, a remarkable relationship between elephants and termites creates a waterhole – a green oasis which is central to every animal's life. The story follows an extraordinary community of creatures, that call the waterhole ‘home' over a season in their lives. They range from a family of elephants to a pair of hornbills (aka ‘Zazu' of The Lion King) alongside dung-beetles, chameleons, bullfrogs, geese and killifish.

name: Guy Martin: Proper Jobs
summary:
Guy Martin: Proper Jobs is a four-part series commissioned for U&Dave and free streaming service, U.

No stranger to trying new things, Guy Martin's Proper Jobs will see the motorcycle racer, truck fitter, part-time farmer, enthusiastic engineer and sometime television presenter, attempt a variety of different roles that involve a lot of hard graft, no shortage of skill and that perhaps don't get the recognition they deserve.

Guy's not thinking about sitting behind a desk writing monthly highlights or sending a load of emails back and forth here though. No, he wants to get stuck in doing some of the most demanding jobs in the UK.

Guy will fully immerse himself in his new role and undergo all the essential training, live with his co-workers, and by doing so, learn more about the people who do these jobs day in, day out.

The former motorcycle racer will be able to see for himself the local and cultural significance these jobs have today and may have had in the past.

name: Special Ops: To Catch a Criminal
summary:
Gritty factual series revealing the work of elite police forces across the UK.

Formerly titled Special Ops: Crime Squad UK, this behind-the-scenes docu-series follows the investigative work of a variety of specialist units within UK police forces created to crack the toughest of cases. From cyber heists, romance fraud and people trafficking to drugs rings and murder.

The series boasts unique access to the highest-level detective techniques used to tackle crimes where ordinary policing has failed to make progress. This gritty but intelligent series reveals the workings of police operative units made up of the most elite detectives in the country.

Filming with numerous task forces across the country, Special Ops: To Catch a Criminal reveals the real, lived experience of the police officers involved, through exclusive interviews, archive, CCTV and body cam footage.

name: Match Game Hollywood Squares Hour
summary: Contestants compete to win cash prizes in a mash-up of two game show formats, first by trying to match celebrities' answers to fill-in-the-blank questions and then by choosing to either agree or disagree with celebrities' answers to trivia questions.

name: Magic Maker: Isekai Mahou no Tsukurikata
summary: On the night of his 30th birthday, one man's dreams of wielding magic come true after he unexpectedly passes away. He wakes as Sion, a young child in another world. He and his elder sister, Marie, are the children of a lower-class noble family who govern their region. After receiving conflicting messages from their father, Sion and Marie set out on an adventure to uncover the magic.

name: Tu Di Ge Ge Shi Da Lao
summary: The story follows the aloof supreme lord of the myriad realms. He handpicks young girls, each with the potential to ascend as future deities, and embarks on a treacherous quest to reshape the destiny of the realms. Confronting formidable challenges and obstacles, will these fledgling girls triumph in their trials and forge a new world from the ashes of the old?

name: Rented in Finland
summary: What unfolds when four of Korea's biggest stars swap their city lights for the raw wilds of Lapland, where even electricity and running water are a luxury? Brace yourself for a hilarious journey as the City Boys experience the self-sufficient lifestyle of local residents.

name: Amor e Sexo
summary: Is a remarkable TV show that engages audiences in instigating topics within the contemporary universe of human behavior, love and sex. The variety show sparks conversation about delicate topics in an inclusive manner, celebrating differences and quirks of human sexuality, always keeping things light and fun, with comic stage dynamics and an informative tone.

name: Gąska
summary: A comedy story about a group of employees of a franchise supermarket Gąska, operating on the outskirts of a Polish city. It's a story about how it's easier, and definitely funnier, in a group.

name: Sense Appeal
summary:
Sense Appeal is a studio-based dating series that tests all five senses when it comes to choosing a partner. In each episode, singletons get to test the five senses on their potential matches before picking just one of them to take out on a date.

They'll smell, touch, taste, hear, see and score their way to a match!

name: Nutcracker: Backstage with English National Ballet
summary:
This Christmas, Sky Arts goes behind the curtain with English National Ballet and their world premiere of a brand new production of Nutcracker. Having performed a version of the festive ballet every year since it was founded, this year sees the Company take a fresh approach, and the pressure is on to wow audiences more than ever before.   

This new series, Nutcracker: Backstage with English National Ballet showcases what it takes to re-invent a globally renowned classic, seen through the eyes of all the key departments involved. Join the Company's own Artistic Director and Choreographer, Aaron S. Watkin, and Olivier Award-winning Choreographer, Arielle Smith, as well Designer, Dick Bird, the principal dancers, musicians, Music Director and costumiers as they unpack their craft and prepare to stage this iconic ballet. Two documentaries follow the meticulous preparations and the all-important rehearsals which build to the opening night. Audiences can then tune in to the full performance of Nutcracker, captured in all its magic at the London Coliseum.

name: Milkshake! Magic of Science
summary: Olivia finds out how things work with fun experiments you can try at home.

name: Milkshake! Croc Watch
summary: Wildlife presenter Steve Backshall is on an adventure to find crocodiles in South Africa. With help from locals and experts, he dares to get close to some of these ancient creatures.

name: The Taste Test Restaurant
summary: Tom Read Wilson puts brands to the test to see what the nation thinks of supermarket food.

name: Экстрим
summary: Sergei, a factory worker, was assigned to entertain Olga, an important guest from Moscow. And the hard worker couldn't think of anything smarter than to simulate an attempted abduction of a girl in the style of the nineties, where he could "save" her. The result is twofold: Olga fell in love with Sergei, but after she found out that the kidnapping was a fake, she decides to take revenge on her "savior" by extreme methods. And now Sergei has to fight the girl's attempts to put him in prison by her father, a colonel of the Ministry of Internal Affairs, who did not appreciate the prank of a provincial adventurer and his growing feelings for the girl.

name: Muster Dogs: Where Are They Now?
summary: Following the runaway success of Muster Dogs, we check in on our human and canine stars to delve a little deeper into their lives and see what they've been up to since they competed to be crowned Champion Muster Dog.

name: Fanning at Whelans
summary: Iconic music venue Whelan's on Dublin's Wexford street opens its doors to an eclectic mix of musical performances from a host of Irish greats, many who will be stopping off for a chat with host Dave Fanning.

name: On the Rise: JuJu Watkins
summary: JuJu Watkins, along with her family and friends, gives viewers an exclusive look into USC Trojans guards' life and journey on and off the court.

name: Un equipo llamado España. El camino hacia la cuarta
summary: The intimate account of a national team that has been the protagonist of one of the most surprising feats in the history of Spanish sport. Through four vibrant episodes, the frenetic pace of the competition and the coexistence of footballers with very different personalities converge in a story that takes your breath away.

name: Őszinte leszek - Talkshow Osváth Zsolttal
summary:
In the episodes of Őszinte leszek (I'll Be Honest), viewers can witness genuine exchanges of ideas where open-minded public figures, everyday people, and experts freely discuss topics such as artificial intelligence, food prices, bullying, or the urban-rural divide.

Zsolt Osváth has already become known for sharing his honest opinions and staying true to himself, but in this show, his express goal is to spark thought-provoking conversations that encourage everyone to boldly share their own views, inspired by his insightful questions.

previousepisode.name: Fight On, King Planet`s Three Swordsmen!

name: Nobody Asked
summary: Comedians find the smartest answers to the dumbest questions.

previousepisode.name: Not So Fast, Comedians vs. Pro Athletes 4, Drink in Sync

name: Late Night Berlin
summary: Pop culture, politics, music, sport, society and media - Klaas Heufer-Umlauf comments on and discusses the really important topics and is completely subjective.

name: Burning Frost Into Day
summary: In turbulent early Republic of China, Hua Xiaoye, a compassionate acupuncturist, must clear her name after a warlord commander is killed in her clinic. She teams up with Leng Wensheng to uncover the truth.

name: Medalist
summary: Tsukasa Akeuraji teams up with Inori Yuitsuka to make her into a glorious medalist.

name: I'm Getting Married to a Girl I Hate in My Class
summary: High school student Saito Hojo is set to inherit his grandfather's major corporation. First, he must marry Akane Sakuramori, the girl he despises the most, and who hates him just as much. The two are determined to keep their unexpected marriage a secret from their classmates. But as they begin their newlywed life, the distance between them starts to close.

previousepisode.name: I'm Getting Married to a Guy I Hate in My Class

name: Motel California
summary: Ji Gang Hui grew up at Motel California because her father ran the motel in her rural hometown village. Her mother also came from a mixed-raced background. Due to Gang Hui's unusual family background, she was the object of whispers and gossip by the local residents. Gang Hui carried a deep wound in her heart from that time. She liked her childhood friend Cheon Yeon Su, who was her first love, but when she turned 20, she left her hometown and moved to Seoul. 12 years later, she works as an interior designer and is reaching the apex of her career, but, for some reason, she decides to return to her hometown. She reunites with her first love, Cheon Yeon Su. Cheon Yeon Su works as a veterinarian in the village. The only woman he has loved is Gang Hui, but he has received a lot of attention from the farmers who are eager to introduce him to their daughters. In order to avoid these kind of uncomfortable situations, he doesn't clarify the rumor that he is going to marry a fellow veterinarian. His first love Gang Hui appears again after 12 years.

name: The Witch
summary: Dong Jin is recognized as the best in the field of data mining. The reason he majored in statistics at his university was because of Mi Jung and his wish to help her. Dong Jin and Mi Jung attended the same high school and he had crush on her, but she was called a witch. Since Mi Jung was little, strange things occurred around her like all the guys who liked her died or got injured. 10 years after school graduation, Dong Jin happens to meet Mi Jung again. She has now cut herself off from the world, believing her fate is cursed, but she wants to go out into the world. In hopes of Mi Jung breaking out of her shell, Dong in wants to prove that all these unfortunate incidents are not because of her. To prove his thesis, he investigates all the situations when guys around her got hurt. Risking his life, he finally finds the law of misfortune around her.

name: The Queen Who Crowns
summary: Queen Won Kyung, born to Min Je during the Goryeo period, came from a prestigious family of high-ranking officials. Married to Lee Bang Won, son of King Taejo, she supported her husband's ambitions to become King Taejong after his father bypassed him for the throne. As a kingmaker, she helped establish a new regime. However, their relationship soured after Lee Bang Won became king, took concubines, and sought to curb Queen Won Kyung's influence and that of her family.

name: Dream of Golden Years
summary: Xia Xiaolan, a 36-year-old modern executive, finds herself in dire straits when her company collapses and she is forced to take the blame. In her despair, she finds herself transported into another world, becoming an 18-year-old beautiful villager. Her quick wit always manages to create miracles in desperate situations. Xiaolan forges ahead step by step, desperately seeking educational opportunities, believing that "knowledge changes destiny" is an unchanging maxim. Through her own efforts, she overcomes numerous difficulties and is admitted to her dream university. She also embarks on an entrepreneurial journey, starting with low-investment businesses like selling duck eggs and fried dough sticks, and progressing to clothing resales and real estate, quickly building her business acumen. Balancing studies and business, she also encounters a bittersweet romance. In this new spacetime, Xiaolan sheds her former reticence and embraces her destiny. She has a great lover by her side, close family and friends behind her, and loving elders and mentors. She also has a beloved career, hard-earned wealth, and a commitment to giving back to society. Xiaolan's rebirth is a transformative one, an adventurous journey through the business world. It is a lesson learned after experiencing changing times and the ups and downs of fate: whether in the past or present, only determination and courage are true keys to success. Fearless in the face of challenges, she ultimately achieves her goals with her head held high.

name: Female Spies: Courage and Espionage in WWII
summary: During World War II, women of all backgrounds work as spies: Krystyna Skarbek, the Polish aristocrat whose daring exploits earn her the title of "Churchill's favorite spy," Andrée de Jongh, the Belgian girl whose ambitious escape network will save hundreds of Allied airmen, Josephine Baker, the glamorous singer whose fame provides the perfect cover for her anti-Nazi activities, and brothel owner Kitty Schmidt, whose Nazi-run establishment offers both secrets and pleasures.

name: Magical Train Journeys in Switzerland
summary: Explores Switzerland's most fascinating landscapes through railways. From vineyards to lakes to the most beautiful alpine valleys, travellers are offered breathtaking panoramas from train windows and wondrous insights into the country and its people.

previousepisode.name: With The Voralpen-Express From St Gallen To Lucerne

name: NITV News: Summer Yarns
summary: NITV News recaptures the highlights of Indigenous news around the country.

name: After the Sky Fell on Lockerbie
summary: Thirty-five years on, the legacy of Lockerbie lives on. Hear eyewitness accounts from the families, friends and neighbours of those who tragically lost their lives in the most deadly terror attack in Britain.

name: Mountain West Football Championship
summary:
Mountain West Football Championship from 1999 to 2012, the champion of the Mountain West was determined by regular season record. Beginning in 2013, following the expansion to twelve members and the division of the conference into Mountain and West Divisions, the conference championship game was held between the two division winners. The Mountain West is one of four conferences to have its championship game at a campus site, along with the American Athletic Conference, Conference USA, and the Sun Belt Conference. 

The most recent 2022 championship game was the last to feature division winners. On May 20, 2022, the MW announced that it would eliminate its football divisions effective with the 2023 season, instead sending the top two teams in the conference standings to the title game. Two days earlier, the NCAA Division I Council had approved a rule change that gave all FBS conferences full freedom to determine the participants in their football championship games.

The inaugural MW Championship Game was played on December 7, 2013, at Fresno State's Bulldog Stadium.
